title: Write a postmortem when work fails

steps.do: Check whether the change meets a postmortem trigger: a handoff failed twice, a customer-visible failure, data loss, a reversed one-way door or a request.
Draft a blameless postmortem with timeline, contributing causes, actions and lessons, citing every source.
Update the affected process record and open a handoff for each action that needs work.

done_criteria.check: Does the postmortem name no person as a cause, and does every action have one owner and a due date?
